title: Akbar: more conquests, court, taxes and the Sikhs

boxes.title: More conquests & Rajputs
head: Item
Fact
rows: Bengal to Afghanistan, Kashmir to the **Godavari**

boxes.title: Revenue: more
items: Todar Mal earlier served **Sher Shah**; Zabti **1580**, paid in **cash**

boxes.title: Court: more
head: Who
Fact
rows: Killed by ==**Bir Singh Bundela**== at Salim's instance; **Ayar-i-Danish** (Panchatantra)
Bairam's son; Hindi dohas; Persian Baburnama

boxes.title: Taxes & religion: more
items: Jesuit second mission **1591**; Din-i-Ilahi never forced; members **Abul Fazl, Faizi, Shaikh Mubarak**
Shah Jahan: pilgrim tax at **Banaras, Allahabad**; ==**Kavindracharya**== sought abolition
Aurangzeb's jizya: **12 / 24 / 48** dirhams by income; exempt women, slaves, children below **14**
Also abolished: **Zain-ul-Abidin** (jizya, cow slaughter); Shah Jahan (**Sijda**); **Sikandar Lodi** (grain tax)

boxes.title: Sikh Gurus & Mughals
head: Guru
Fact
rows: "==**Hind-di-Chadar**=="; **Anandpur Sahib**; **116** hymns; beheaded **24 Nov 1675**, Chandni Chowk

boxes.title: Emperors & AP angle
items: Akbar ==**unlettered**==; Humayun: foundation of Mughal painting; Jahangir: zenith
Golconda's **Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah** friendly; Akbar sent **Masud Beg**
